# ONE BY ONE (OBO)

> Free desktop software by Pollyne Studios for mixed-media animation on paper.

ONE BY ONE imports a video or image sequence, arranges frames on printable PDF sheets, and helps users reanimate hand-decorated frames after scanning. It supports drawing, painting and collage on paper.

## Product facts

- Free to download and use; no subscription or account required.
- Runs on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 13 or later, and 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11.
- Project files stay on the user's device.
- OBO is desktop software; the website is its product, tutorial and download page.
